name: The Life of Me
source:
The story revolves around Oliver, an eighteen-year-old man that has just moved back to the town he grew up in. Admist old friends and new aquaintances, he learns about the world of grown-ups; reponsibilities, sexual exploration, and that everyone has secrets they wish to keep hidden.

Will he find love, uncover the secrets of his friends or just learn to enjoy what the world has to offer?

[From [url=https://thonduil.itch.io/the-life-of-me]Itch.io[/url]]
